The '''Listehol Run''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that connected several [[Star system/Legends|systems]], near [[Werncin 3]] in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
[[File:Listehol_Campaign.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The [[Listehol Campaign]].]]

[[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] battled [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] on the Listehol Run in his career in the pre-[[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].<ref name="TCW6.8">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.8|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.8]]</ref> [[Borun Call]] and [[Slar-dan ti Gardi]] were two slavers who were notorious for enslaving [[Sentience/Legends|sapients]] along the Listehol Run.<ref name="J10">{{JournalCite|10|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}}</ref>

The route was the site of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Listehol Campaign|campaign]] shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order]].<ref name="TEGTW" />
